configurePresets.name: _base
configurePresets.description: Shared baseline for TinyHook presets: Ninja, C++20, MinSizeRel, compile_commands.json, and per-preset build/install directories.

configurePresets.name: _fetch
configurePresets.description: Enables TinyHook's top-level dependency provider so find_package() can resolve pinned development dependencies through FetchContent.

configurePresets.name: _unix
configurePresets.description: Applies the common GCC/Clang warning and section-splitting flags used by Unix-like development presets.

configurePresets.name: macos-small
configurePresets.description: Configure the native macOS host and tools for a size-optimized MinSizeRel build with fetched dependencies, dead stripping, and IPO.

configurePresets.name: macos-vm
configurePresets.description: Configure the macOS runtime without embedding the Luau compiler; build the separate th-compile tool for ahead-of-time script compilation.

configurePresets.name: linux-small
configurePresets.description: Configure the native Linux host and tools for a size-optimized MinSizeRel build with fetched dependencies, section garbage collection, and IPO.

configurePresets.name: linux-relay
configurePresets.description: Configure the minimal Linux relay without Luau support; useful for transport/core testing and footprint measurements.

configurePresets.name: linux-sanitize
configurePresets.description: Configure a Clang debug build of the relay with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer enabled.

configurePresets.name: system
configurePresets.description: Configure TinyHook using only externally installed packages; the project dependency provider is not enabled.

configurePresets.name: windows-x86
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile 32-bit Windows client, hook DLL, demo, and tests with MinGW. Uses static runtimes and the GCC i686 -fno-declone-ctor-dtor workaround.

configurePresets.name: msvc-x86
configurePresets.description: Configure a native 32-bit Windows build with Visual Studio 2022, static MSVC runtime, UTF-8 source handling, and IPO.

configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile 64-bit Windows client, hook DLL, demo, and tests with MinGW using static GCC/libstdc++ runtimes.

configurePresets.name: msvc-x64
configurePresets.description: Configure a native 64-bit Windows build with Visual Studio 2022, static MSVC runtime, UTF-8 source handling, and IPO.

configurePresets.name: clang-x86
configurePresets.description: Native Windows x86 build with clang-cl, LLD, and the static MSVC runtime. Run in a matching MSVC developer environment.

configurePresets.name: clang-x64
configurePresets.description: Native Windows x64 build with clang-cl, LLD, and the static MSVC runtime. Run in a matching MSVC developer environment.
